endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2
endpoint.ref_validation: For caller-provided refs, exact ID/URL binding match before credential lookup and HTTP; no redirect or selecting a ref-supplied endpoint

query.cursor.cursor: exact SDK cursor wire pointer, omitted initially
query.cursor.limit: effective bounded page size as uint64 string

response.mapping: Generated typed datastores and independent scoped refs, no inferred cluster parent; exact IDs/projectId and cursor uint64 strings validated
response.number_protection: Source JSON numbers are lexically validated and stored in onec.ProtectedNumber without precision conversion; formatting/JSON/Text redacts, Reveal is explicit

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError

pagination.continuation: returned cursor.next forwarded unchanged; SDK cursor scope/endpoint/revision/fingerprint
pagination.terminal: Unconfirmed: no absent/empty/zero sentinel invented; no complete collection claim, no-progress protocol error preserves observed items
